results.name: hs_allocate_script_node_table
results.evidence: Calls data_new("script node",0x4a39) to allocate a fresh syntax-node datum array, sets its 'in use'/reserved flag byte, runs data_delete_all() on it, and if a live network/game-globals structure exists (DAT_00746f8c) swaps it into that structure's node-table pointer/tag fields, freeing the old block via GlobalFree; matches naming hint 'hs_allocate' (via string 'script node').
results.summary: Allocates (or reallocates and hot-swaps) the datum array used to hold compiled HS syntax-node data.

results.name: hs_scripts_compile_and_link
results.evidence: Saves/clears the active node table via FUN_00483100, checks whether existing runtime bytecode can be reused (globals count==0 && script count>0) before falling back to hs_compile_source()+hs_compile_postprocess(); restores the previous DAT_0087a474 table when its single char parameter is non-zero.
results.summary: (Re)compiles and postprocesses/links all HS scripts into a fresh syntax-node table, optionally restoring the previously active table afterward.

results.name: hs_scripts_reload
results.evidence: Reallocates the node table (FUN_00483100), optionally finishes a pending compile via hs_scripts_compile_and_link(0), marks two other datum arrays (DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468) dirty and empties them with data_delete_all(), then calls FUN_00489ef0.
results.summary: Full reset/reload of the HS scripting subsystem's syntax-node table plus two auxiliary datum arrays after scripts are rebuilt or recompiled.

results.name: hs_scripts_free
results.evidence: If a node table (DAT_0087a474) exists, runs the garbage-collect pass FUN_00483310, zeroes and GlobalFree()s the block when DAT_007102fc marks it heap-owned, then clears the two auxiliary datum arrays' 'in use' flag bytes (offset+0x24) and calls FUN_0048a130.
results.summary: Tears down and frees the currently active HS syntax-node table and marks the two auxiliary datum arrays unused.

results.name: hs_syntax_node_garbage_collect
results.evidence: Iterates the active node table's entries via FUN_004d0630 (a used-slot iterator) and calls datum_delete() on every entry whose flag byte lacks bit 0x8, i.e. removes unreferenced syntax nodes.
results.summary: Garbage-collects unreferenced entries out of the active HS syntax-node datum table.

results.name: hs_script_find_by_name
results.evidence: Linear-scans the scripts array at DAT_00746f8c+0x4a0 (stride 0x5c) doing a manual case-insensitive two-byte-at-a-time compare of each entry's name against the given string, returning the matching index or -1; used by hs_add_script to detect duplicate script names.
results.summary: Looks up a compiled script's index by name in the runtime scripts table, or returns -1 if none matches.

results.name: hs_global_get_type
results.evidence: Given a packed global index in EAX (high bit selects the builtin table PTR_PTR_0068b398 vs. the script-defined globals array at DAT_00746f8c+0x4ac, stride 0x5c), returns CONCAT22(hi-word, the global's type field at offset+4/+0x20) -- same table-selection logic as hs_global_get_address/hs_parse_variable.
results.summary: Returns the declared type (and a packed high word) of a global variable identified by a builtin/script-global packed index.

results.name: hs_null_with_params_evaluate
results.evidence: 5-byte stub that just returns *(short*)(in_EAX+4), i.e. the node's stored type field; consistent with being one of the per-node-type 'evaluate' callbacks (table DAT_0065b668 indexed in hs_parse_primitive) for a node type that is a no-op placeholder carrying only its own type.
results.summary: Trivial evaluate handler for a 'null with params' HS syntax-node type that just returns the node's type field.

results.name: hs_global_get_address
results.evidence: Mirrors hs_global_get_type's builtin-vs-script-global selection (high bit of packed index chooses PTR_PTR_0068b398 or the DAT_00746f8c+0x4ac globals array, stride 0x5c) but returns the storage address itself rather than a type field.
results.summary: Returns the storage address of a global variable identified by a builtin/script-global packed index.

results.name: chimera__get_global_index
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed: linear-searches the ~491-entry (0x1eb) builtin global-name table PTR_PTR_0068b398 then the script-defined globals array via __stricmp, returning a packed index (bit 0x8000 = builtin) or 0xffff; used everywhere a global name must be resolved (hs_parse_set, hs_parse_variable, hs_add_global, chimera__execute_script, autocomplete scan).
results.summary: Resolves a global-variable name string to a packed builtin/script-global index, or 0xffff if unknown.

results.name: hs_find_function_by_name
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed: string data shows deprecated-alias handling ('player_effect_set_max_rumble' remapped to 'player_effect_set_max_vibrate') then a __stricmp linear search over the 0x20a-entry HS function table PTR_DAT_00688b58.
results.summary: Looks up an HS script function's table index by name, applying one legacy name-alias rewrite first.

results.name: hs_gametype_flag_test
results.evidence: Tests bit `param_1` of DAT_006b14ac's low word against the caller-supplied flag byte in_AL, and independently tests the corresponding bit of the high word as a 'forbidden unless set' override; used repeatedly by FUN_00483600 with values 1..6.
results.summary: Tests whether a given per-gametype capability bit is satisfied by the current gametype flags.

results.name: hs_function_valid_for_all_gametypes
results.evidence: After a couple of bit tests on DAT_006b14ac, calls hs_gametype_flag_test for flag values 1,2,3,4,6,5 in sequence (Halo's six non-'none' multiplayer game types) and only returns true if every one passes.
results.summary: Checks whether a script function/global is applicable across every one of Halo's built-in multiplayer game types.

results.name: chimera__autocomplete_match_and_add
results.evidence: Computes the length of the shared prefix string DAT_006b14a4 and does an __strnicmp against the candidate string (unaff_EDI); on a match appends it to the results array DAT_006b14b4, bounded by the shared count/limit globals DAT_006b14b0/DAT_006b14a0.
results.summary: Tests one candidate string against the current autocomplete prefix and appends it to the results array on a match.

results.name: chimera__autocomplete_scan_string_array
results.evidence: Same prefix strnicmp/append logic as chimera__autocomplete_match_and_add, but looped over an array of `in_AX-in_CX` string pointers starting at param_1+in_CX*4 -- a batch version for tables of fixed keyword strings (e.g. the startup/dormant/continuous/static table).
results.summary: Scans an array of candidate strings against the current autocomplete prefix, appending every match.

results.name: chimera__autocomplete_scan_globals
results.evidence: Loops over a (count, base-pointer, stride) global-array description, resolves each candidate's global index via chimera__get_global_index and gates builtin ones on hs_function_valid_for_all_gametypes, then reuses the same prefix strnicmp/append logic as chimera__autocomplete_match_and_add.
results.summary: Scans a table of global-variable names against the current autocomplete prefix, filtering builtins by gametype applicability.

results.name: chimera__autocomplete_add_keywords
results.evidence: Calls chimera__autocomplete_match_and_add (FUN_00483690) twice with no visible arguments besides the ambient prefix state; the function's own referenced strings are exactly 'script' and 'global', HS's two special-form keywords.
results.summary: Adds the 'script' and 'global' special-form keywords to the autocomplete results if they match the current prefix.

results.name: chimera__autocomplete_add_startup
results.evidence: Calls chimera__autocomplete_scan_string_array (FUN_004836f0) with &PTR_s_startup_00688b3c, the same 'startup/dormant/continuous/static' script-type keyword table referenced by hs_add_script's type-check string.
results.summary: Adds the HS script-type keywords (startup/dormant/continuous/static) to the autocomplete results if they match the current prefix.

results.name: chimera__autocomplete_gather
results.evidence: Resets the shared prefix/count/output globals (DAT_006b14a0/a4/b0/b4/ac), then walks an 18-entry (0x12) function-pointer table PTR_FUN_00689380 invoking each category whose bit is set in param_1 (two known members are chimera__autocomplete_add_keywords/_add_startup), and finally _qsort()s the collected matches with FUN_00617340.
results.summary: Driver that gathers autocomplete candidates for a given prefix across a set of selectable categories and returns them sorted.

results.name: hs_file_display_name_compare
results.evidence: For each of its two struct arguments it builds a display/localized name via the same FUN_00555ec0/FUN_00556000/FUN_005560d0 helper sequence, then __stricmp()s the two resulting names; used only as the qsort comparator passed from FUN_00483e20 and the file-scanning logic at 0x483f40.
results.summary: qsort comparator that orders two file-entry records by their display/localized name, case-insensitively.

results.name: hs_rebuild_source
results.evidence: Naming hint plus strings 'data\\%s', 'scripts', 'data\\global_scripts.hsc' match: builds the 'data\\scripts' directory path, enumerates *.hsc files with the FUN_00555720/b90/c10/ec0/f80 file-iteration wrappers, sorts them via hs_file_display_name_compare, then appends every file except global_scripts.hsc into the combined source buffer, returning whether anything changed.
results.summary: Rebuilds the combined HS source buffer from every .hsc file in the scripts directory (excluding global_scripts.hsc), sorted by display name.

results.name: hs_rebuild_source_scan_tail
results.evidence: Body is essentially the same file-gather/rename/qsort/concatenate sequence as hs_rebuild_source (same helper calls FUN_00555c10/qsort/hs_file_display_name_compare/FUN_005560d0/FUN_00556000/FUN_00555720, same '.hsc' extension check) but operates purely on caller-frame stack offsets (in_stack_00000010/0018/0138) with no real prologue of its own, suggesting Ghidra split a shared tail/continuation of that routine into its own 'function'; the existing name hs_null_evaluate does not match this file-scanning behaviour at all.
results.summary: Continuation of the .hsc file-gathering/concatenation logic (near-duplicate of hs_rebuild_source's body); the prior name 'hs_null_evaluate' does not match what the code actually does.

results.name: hs_compile_source
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by the exact string 'scripts successfully compiled.': resets all compile-state globals, calls data_delete_all(), then hs_compile() on every registered script's source range, printing a success message via FUN_004c67c0 (console print) if every script compiled cleanly.
results.summary: Recompiles every registered HS script's source text in turn, printing a success message if all of them compiled without error.

results.name: hs_help_print_function
results.evidence: Looks up a function name via hs_find_function_by_name, formats its full signature+doc string with hs_format_function_signature (FUN_00484300), then prints it to the console via chimera__console_out one line at a time, splitting on newline with FUN_006257e0 (a strchr-style search).
results.summary: Console command handler that prints a single HS function's formatted signature and documentation string.

results.name: hs_doc
results.evidence: Naming hint plus the literal string 'hs_doc.txt' match: opens that file and writes every one of the 0x20a HS functions' formatted signature (via hs_format_function_signature) followed by its documentation string.
results.summary: Writes the signature and documentation string of every registered HS script function to hs_doc.txt.

results.name: hs_format_function_signature
results.evidence: Builds a '(name arg1<type> arg2<type> ...)' style prototype string for a function-table entry from PTR_DAT_00688b58, looking up each parameter's type name in the PTR_s_unparsed_00688a78 type-name table (the same table used by hs_parse_variable/hs_add_global for type names).
results.summary: Formats a human-readable '(name arg<type> ...)' prototype string for an HS function-table entry.

results.name: chimera__execute_script
results.evidence: Already-named and behaviour-confirmed: the literal string '(set %s)' plus logic that auto-wraps a bare 'global value' into '(set global value)' or a bare 'function' into '(function)' via chimera__get_global_index before compiling (hs_compile_expression) and running (FUN_0048a250) matches Chimera's documented ability to type unparenthesized commands into its console; also triggers hs_rebuild_source+hs_compile_source when DAT_006b14a8 requests a script reload.
results.summary: Compiles and immediately executes a single console/script command line, auto-wrapping bare global-set or bare-call syntax, and triggers a full script reload when requested.

results.name: hs_parse_if
results.evidence: Naming hint plus exact string match 'i expected (if <condition> <then> [<else>]).': validates that the node has a condition child, a then child, and an optional else child, recursively type-checking each via hs_parse (FUN_00486420).
results.summary: Parses/type-checks an (if <condition> <then> [<else>]) special-form syntax node.

results.name: hs_parse_cond_recursive
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by its three distinctive error strings about cond argument pairs and syntax-node allocation failure; recursively rewrites a chain of (condition result) pairs into nested if-nodes via repeated datum_new() allocations.
results.summary: Recursively desugars a cond special-form's list of condition/result pairs into a chain of nested if syntax nodes.

results.name: hs_parse_set
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by its four distinctive error strings ('i expected a variable to set and a value.', 'i expected an assignment value.', etc.); resolves the target as a global via chimera__get_global_index, checks its type against the value's parsed type, then parses the value node.
results.summary: Parses/type-checks a (set <global> <value>) special-form syntax node.

results.name: hs_get_parameter_indices
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by the exact string 'the %s call requires %d arguments.': walks a node's argument-list chain collecting each argument's node index into an output array until either it runs out of expected arguments or the list, reporting an arity error on mismatch.
results.summary: Collects a function call node's argument-node indices into an output array, reporting an error if the argument count doesn't match.

results.name: hs_verify_binary_numeric_args
results.evidence: Fetches two argument node indices via hs_get_parameter_indices(...,2), then cross-propagates an unresolved (type 0) argument's type from the other argument via hs_parse (FUN_00486420), defaulting both to type 6 if neither is resolved -- a generic 'these two arguments must share one type' checker.
results.summary: Type-check callback that forces a function's two arguments to resolve to a single shared (numeric) type.

results.name: hs_verify_object_or_unit_args
results.evidence: Same two-argument fetch-and-cross-propagate pattern as hs_verify_binary_numeric_args, but the type-range tests (0x1f<type<0x25 or 5<type<9) target the object/unit-family type-id ranges rather than plain numerics.
results.summary: Type-check callback that forces a function's two arguments to resolve to a compatible object/unit-family type.

results.name: hs_compile_expression
results.evidence: Copies the given source text into the shared compiled-source buffer (GlobalAlloc'ing it or reusing the runtime buffer per DAT_0069e8d4), tokenizes it via hs_tokenize (FUN_00486120), then wraps the resulting node in a synthetic call/argument pair via two datum_new() allocations before returning the new root node index; used by chimera__execute_script to compile a single console command.
results.summary: Tokenizes and wraps a single standalone expression string into a syntax-node tree ready for immediate evaluation.

results.name: hs_source_buffer_append
results.evidence: Grows the shared compiled-source heap block DAT_006b14c0 (via GlobalAlloc/GlobalReAlloc) by `unaff_EBX` bytes, copies param_1's bytes into the new space, updates the length global DAT_006b14bc, and NUL-terminates -- the buffer-growth primitive underlying hs_compile/hs_compile_expression.
results.summary: Appends raw bytes to the shared growable HS compiled-source buffer, reallocating as needed.

results.name: hs_compile
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by the exact string "couldn't allocate memory for compiled source.": copies the given source range into the compile buffer via hs_source_buffer_append, then repeatedly tokenizes (hs_tokenize) and parses (hs_parse_primitive/hs_parse_nonprimitive) each top-level expression until EOF or error, producing an error message/offset pair on failure.
results.prototype: void __cdecl hs_compile(int source_length_field, int source_ptr_field, int *error_message, int *error_offset)
results.summary: Compiles one script's source text into syntax nodes, returning an error message and offset on failure.

results.name: hs_verify_source_offset
results.evidence: Naming hint plus exact string match 'bad source offset (you need to recompile.)': a one-line bounds check that an offset (in_ECX) falls within [0, DAT_006b14bc).
results.summary: Validates that a source-text offset still falls within the current compiled-source buffer, flagging a recompile-needed error otherwise.

results.name: hs_compile_postprocess
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by its six distinctive 'you need to recompile' error strings; walks every allocated syntax node validating its type, resolving function names via hs_find_function_by_name, validating script indices and source offsets via hs_verify_source_offset, and re-parsing primitives, failing the whole pass on any inconsistency.
results.summary: Second compilation pass that resolves function references and re-validates every syntax node's type/offset consistency after hs_compile_source.

results.name: hs_add_global
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by its five distinctive error strings about global declaration syntax; parses a (global<type> <name> <value>) form, validates the type via hs_format_function_signature's type table (FUN_004875c0), checks for name collisions via chimera__get_global_index, and allocates storage on success.
results.summary: Parses and registers a (global<type> <name> <value>) declaration as a new script-defined global variable.

results.name: hs_add_script
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by its ten distinctive error strings covering script declaration syntax, return types, and stub-override rules; parses (script <type> [<returntype>] <name> <body>), validates the type/name against the scripts table via hs_script_find_by_name, and allows only static scripts to override same-typed stub scripts.
results.summary: Parses and registers a (script <type> ... <name> <body>) declaration, enforcing naming, typing, and stub-override rules.

results.name: hs_tokenize
results.evidence: Several sibling functions' naming hints point to 'hs_tokenize' via the shared "i couldn't allocate a syntax node." string, and this function is exactly that dispatcher: allocates one syntax-node datum, marks it 'not a list' unless the text starts with '(', and calls hs_tokenize_primitive or hs_tokenize_nonprimitive accordingly.
results.summary: Allocates one syntax-node datum for the next token/expression and dispatches to the primitive or nonprimitive tokenizer.

results.name: hs_tokenize_primitive
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by the exact string 'this quoted constant is unterminated.': handles both quoted-string literals (scanning to the closing '"') and bare-word primitives (scanning to whitespace/')'/';').
results.summary: Tokenizes a single primitive value (quoted string or bare word) from the source cursor.

results.name: hs_tokenize_nonprimitive
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by its two distinctive strings 'this left parenthesis is unmatched.' and 'this expression is empty.': repeatedly calls hs_tokenize on child expressions inside a parenthesized list until the matching ')' or an error/EOF.
results.summary: Tokenizes a parenthesized list expression by recursively tokenizing each child element until the closing paren.

results.name: skip_whitespace
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by the exact string 'unterminated comment.': a small state machine advancing a cursor (in_EDX) over whitespace, ';'-style line comments, and ';* ... *;' block comments.
results.summary: Advances a source-text cursor past whitespace and both line and block HS comment syntax.

results.name: hs_parse
results.evidence: Mirrors hs_tokenize's dispatcher role for the parse phase: given a node index and an expected type, sets the node's resolved type if unset, then calls hs_parse_primitive or hs_parse_nonprimitive depending on the node's primitive flag; called repeatedly from every parse_* routine in this batch (hs_parse_if, hs_parse_set, hs_parse_cond_recursive's callers, hs_verify_binary_numeric_args, etc.) to recursively parse/type-check a child node.
results.summary: Recursively parses/type-checks a single syntax node against an expected type, dispatching to the primitive or nonprimitive parser.

results.name: hs_parse_primitive
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by its three distinctive strings about void-typed expressions and unsupported types: for a primitive node either resolves it as a variable via hs_parse_variable or invokes the per-type constant-evaluate callback table DAT_0065b668.
results.summary: Parses/type-checks a primitive (non-list) syntax node as either a variable reference or a typed constant.

results.name: hs_parse_variable
results.evidence: Already-named and code-confirmed by its two distinctive strings about invalid variable names and type mismatches: resolves the node's text as a global name via chimera__get_global_index, looks up that global's declared type, and checks/records it against the node's expected type.
results.summary: Parses/type-checks a bare-word syntax node as a reference to a global variable.
